objects.description: [TONESHELL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1239) has used RC4 encryption in C2 communications.(Citation: 2022 November_TrendMicro_Earth Preta_Toneshell_Pubload) [TONESHELL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1239) variants used a randomly generated variable length (0x20 - 0x200 bytes) rolling XOR key to encrypt and decrypt network packets.(Citation: Zscaler)
